title: Group Policy not applying
symptom: A new company setting pushed by Group Policy has not appeared on one PC
user_description: Everyone else got the new HR shared drive this morning, but it's not showing on my PC. I work from home some days, if that matters.

options.text: Check the PC can reach the domain (in the office or on the VPN), run gpupdate /force, check the result with gpresult /r, and sign out or restart if asked
options.why: Group Policy only updates when the PC can reach a domain controller. gpupdate /force fetches it now and gpresult /r shows which policies applied.

options.text: Reinstall Windows so the PC picks up all policies fresh
options.why: Far too drastic. A policy refresh usually solves this in minutes.

options.text: Add the setting by hand in the registry
options.why: Manual changes are not managed, can be overwritten and hide the real reason the policy did not apply.

options.text: Tell her to wait a few weeks for it to appear
options.why: If the PC cannot reach the domain, waiting will not help, and she needs the drive now.

hints: How does a PC receive Group Policy?
She works from home some days. Why might that matter?
Is there a command to fetch and check policies now?
real_world_tip: Some policies, like drive maps and software installs, only apply at sign-in or restart, so gpupdate may ask you to sign out.
